Package neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram

Class EngineeringDiagramDeliveryComparison

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram.EngineeringDiagramDeliveryComparison
public final class EngineeringDiagramDeliveryComparison extends Object
Compares two independently assessed engineering-diagram deliveries.

The comparison consumes only complete EngineeringDiagramDeliveryAssessment.Report instances. It classifies every declared artifact as added, removed, modified, or unchanged and maps changes onto deterministic engineering-review scopes. Directory paths are deliberately excluded from the comparison fingerprint so equivalent transferred copies produce identical evidence.

A comparison does not reconstruct or execute a process model, repeat DEXPI semantic assessment, approve a drawing, decide management of change, establish fitness for construction, or claim standards conformance.
